question: Give NVIDIA's Data Center revenue for each quarter from Q2 FY2026 through Q2 FY2027 and the QoQ growth for each.
grading: Each quarterly value ±0.5% USD millions; QoQ ±0.5pp; fail if Compute & Networking segment figures substituted or quarters mislabeled
answer: Data Center market-platform revenue (USD millions) / calculated QoQ growth: Q2 FY2026: 41,096 / 5.0726%; Q3 FY2026: 51,215 / 24.6228%; Q4 FY2026: 62,314 / 21.6714%; Q1 FY2027: 75,246 / 20.7530%; Q2 FY2027: 89,023 / 18.3093%. Q2 FY2026 growth uses the Q1 FY2026 baseline of USD 39,112 million. These are Data Center figures, not Compute & Networking segment revenue. [G19-E1, G19-E2]

output.answer:
Here are NVIDIA's Data Center revenues by quarter from **Q2 FY2026 through Q2 FY2027**, with quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) growth rates.

| Quarter | Data Center Revenue | QoQ Growth |
|---------|---------------------|------------|
| Q2 FY2026 | **$41.1 billion** | +5.4% |
| Q3 FY2026 | **$51.2 billion** | +24.6% |
| Q4 FY2026 | **$62.3 billion** | +21.7% |
| Q1 FY2027 | **$75.2 billion** | +20.7% |
| Q2 FY2027 | **$89.02 billion** | +18.3% |

### Notes & Sources:
- **Q2 FY2026** ($41.1B): Reported in Aug 2025; total quarterly revenue was $46.7B with data center performance cited as topping out at $41.1B.  
  Source: Yahoo Finance
- **Q3 FY2026** ($51.2B): Official NVIDIA announcement — "Record Data Center revenue of $51.2 billion, up 25% from Q2."  
  Source: [NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-third-quarter-fiscal-2026)
- **Q4 FY2026** ($62.3B): Official NVIDIA announcement — "Record quarterly Data Center revenue of $62.3 billion, up 22% from Q3."  
  Source: [NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-2026)
- **Q1 FY2027** ($75.2B): Official NVIDIA announcement — "Record Data Center revenue of $75.2 billion, up 92% from a year ago."  
  Source: [NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027)
- **Q2 FY2027** ($89.02B): Announced Aug 2026; total revenue was $96.22B.  
  Source: Yahoo Finance / GuruFocus

### QoQ Methodology:
QoQ growth is calculated vs. the prior quarter's data center revenue (e.g., Q2 FY2026 growth compares to Q1 FY2026's ~$39.0B). The figures show NVIDIA's data center revenue more than doubled from ~$41B to ~$89B over this five-quarter span, though the sequential growth rate has gradually decelerated from the mid-20s to the high teens as the revenue base expands.
